dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: The lateral margins are smooth and continuous, exhibiting no significant asymmetrical bulges or structural indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: The median pixel intensity represents a light grey to off-white skin tone across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Faint, low-frequency dark-pixel clusters are localized primarily toward the posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Transitions between the light-grey base and the darker posterior regions are diffuse with no sharp gradient slopes.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, linear marks with slight contrast differences are visible on the posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear rake marks are visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, dark, oval aperture representing the blowhole is clearly visible on the anterior dorsal midline.
